modules.name: adversarial_path_balance
modules.caution: A zero model-side scale does not itself disable opponent updates or forward/buffer effects.

modules.name: class_related_alignment_priority
modules.caution: Pixel priority preserves within-pixel class proportions; channel reweighting changes the joint soft-label target. Wrong predicted classes can be amplified.

modules.name: alignment_reliability
modules.caution: Do not normalize away intended attenuation, equate high confidence with correctness, impose a universal probability gate, or turn a regional prior into truth.

modules.name: confusable_class_pair_separation
modules.caution: A distance on frozen raw inputs supplies no intended model gradient. Pseudo-label errors and multimodal class structure can invalidate a single-centroid remedy. No MCC or CCA-LSC implementation is claimed.

modules.name: class_contribution_and_mass_correction
modules.caution: Model mean responses do not identify true target priors. Do not force equal predicted class proportions or boost unsupported rare pseudo-classes.

modules.name: shared_gradient_conflict_control
modules.caution: Raw-gradient compatibility does not guarantee AdamW descent, source generalization or target quality. Two earlier mild-conflict cases showed no Cashew quality gain.

modules.name: component_readiness_and_learning_policy
modules.caution: Frozen parameters can coexist with changing buffers. Prepared states are not adopted without exact state binding.

modules.name: supervision_dose_and_exposure

plugins.migration: Preserve the actual originating loss, reduction and selection method. Do not enable a forbidden legacy pool in a current-human-only task.
Do not automatically rewrite human labels using model confidence, feature distance or prior. Preserve annotation revisions.

plugins.selection: Legal training patches; source Cashew AEF relation, rising Cashew probability and approved regional prior as soft evidence. No universal high-p2 gate, non-Cashew prototype requirement, geographic quota or preset patch-count cap.
plugins.legacy_behavior: Production v4 preserves its one occurrence per selected patch across 128 normal optimizer updates, age and pixel-dose limits, task dose bounds and existing selection constraints. These are version-specific, not universal module defaults. Do not advertise mutable horizon or new loss controls before the task executor supports them.

plugins.migration: Positive supervision must remain independent when negatives are adjusted or disabled. Legacy mapping at each time t is w_Hneg(t)=w_neg(t), w_Hpos(t)=w_neg(t)*positive_scale, with the same batches, masks, sign means, auxiliary BN behavior and schedule.

plugin_contract.loss_contract: Declare masks, differentiable paths, reduction and effective independent sign weights; absent support produces zero contribution and an absent-support report, not successful learning.
plugin_contract.overlap_policy: Do not add duplicate pixel losses across negative sources by default. Keep overlap ownership explicit. Current authorized human labels take precedence over automatic hypotheses; unresolved human conflicts remain recorded and inactive pending correction.
plugin_contract.protected_data: Preserve task-specific held-out locations, evaluation geometry and human-marked protection. Final evaluation labels are not selection inputs; annotations from different years are not automatically interchangeable.
plugin_contract.disable_semantics: Stops future contribution; does not undo past parameter updates. Undo requires restoring the complete bound training state. Resume does not renew a consumed pool budget.
plugin_contract.quality_boundary: Training-fit changes and reduced mapped area are not target generalization evidence. Missing holdout support remains unknown.
plugin_contract.cost: Reuse loaders, cached feature evidence and compatible forwards; one continuing expert chooses relevant plugins without a separate Agent or parameter grid per plugin.

modules.caution: Three negative origins stay distinct and human positives have independent controls. The current human ratio interface cannot provide arbitrary positive-only supervision; adapter design is not implementation. Source CE weights remain unchanged; prior and automatic labels remain soft evidence and hypotheses.

registry_contract: Only implemented, version-bound and task-authorized entries appear as executable capabilities.
One registry supplies control semantics, callable implementation, packet descriptions, output schema and execution checks.
D/model paths, detach, loss reduction, state and optimizer ownership are explicit.
Disable/neutral behavior preserves the declared baseline, including legacy clipped soft-label mass.
The expert can select, adjust, disable and withdraw authorized modules without per-action human confirmation.
New methods may be developed in an authorized custom branch; formal integration is a separate version-bound capability.
Per-tile action selection does not require a parameter sweep or every module to be tried.
Cross-tile empirical knowledge retains compatible repetition, null/adverse cases and dependence within geography.
